endpoint_title: Number and Percentage of Participants With Pathologic Complete Response (pCR) Rate
auditor_notes: Absence of residual invasive cancer in resected breast/nodes after neoadjuvant therapy. (Registry description oddly claims pCR 'assessed according to RECIST 1.1', but the endpoint is pathologic CR, not ORR.)

endpoint_title: The Primary Outcome Measure Was Any Response at 6 Months
auditor_notes: Benign-tumor (hemangioma) response by size/color: any of complete / nearly complete / partial per study-specific criteria; includes color-only changes. Not an oncology objective-response endpoint.

endpoint_title: Bone Scan Response Rate
auditor_notes: CR/PR of radiotracer uptake on isotope bone scan per protocol-specific Bone Scan Time Point Response Criteria - imaging-modality-specific, not RECIST-type objective response.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants Who Achieved Major Molecular Response (MMR) During the First 12 Months
auditor_notes: BCR-ABL1(IS) <=0.1% by 12 months - molecular response, explicitly excluded.

endpoint_title: The Incidence of Investigator-assessed, Confirmed Objective Responses (ORR) Per RECIST 1.1 (Phase 2)
auditor_notes: Confirmed objective responses per RECIST 1.1, investigator-assessed.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) as Determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BIRC) - Platinum Refractory Subgroup
auditor_notes: BOR of CR or PR / randomized participants; CR and PR defined per RECIST-style rules in description.

endpoint_title: Complete Response Rate (CR)
auditor_notes: Complete remission rate only (MDS); no PR component.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR)
auditor_notes: BOR of confirmed CR or PR per RECIST 1.1, investigator-assessed.

endpoint_title: Clinical Response Rate at 3 Months
human_actual_endpoint_type: clinical response (NCI-WG + flow cytometry) at 3 months
auditor_notes: Description says 'combined morphological [NCI-WG criteria] + flow cytometry criteria' without enumerating which response categories (CR/PR/nPR) count as response; flow-cytometry component suggests MRD-flavored composite. Insufficient to confirm strict CR+PR ORR; also a 3-month landmark.

endpoint_title: Overall Response Rate
auditor_notes: OR = CR + PR per RECIST v1.1, responses confirmed at 4 weeks.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With Complete Response Per Lugano Criteria
auditor_notes: Complete response per Lugano 2014 only; no PR component.

endpoint_title: Rate of Complete Response/Complete Remission (CR), as Assessed by Investigator Using Modified International Workshop on Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (IWCLL) 2008 Criteria at Week 25
auditor_notes: Rate of CR/CRi per modified iwCLL 2008 at Week 25 - CR-variant composite (no PR), landmark timepoint.

endpoint_title: MF Participants: Percentage of Participants With Overall Response (OR) - (Clinical Improvement[CI] or Partial Remission[PR] or Complete Remission[CR]) Per International Working Group - Myeloproliferative Neoplasms Research and Treatment (IWG-MRT) Criteria
auditor_notes: Myelofibrosis overall response includes Clinical Improvement (anemia/spleen/symptom response) in addition to CR/PR - broader than CR+PR.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR)
human_actual_endpoint_type: ORR (CR+PR; RECIST 1.1 / Cheson 2014 / RANO by histology)
auditor_notes: BOR of CR or PR among eligible+treated; criteria set depends on tumor type (solid/lymphoma/GBM) but response is strictly CR+PR.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With a Confirmed Tumor Response (Partial Response [PR] or Complete Response [CR] at Least 4 Weeks Apart)
auditor_notes: Confirmed tumor response (PR or CR >=4 weeks apart) per RECIST 1.1.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate, Defined as Complete Remission + Partial Remission + Clinical Improvement
auditor_notes: Title itself defines 'ORR' as CR + PR + Clinical Improvement per IWG-MRT/ELN myelofibrosis criteria - includes CI, broader than CR+PR.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants Who Achieved a Major Response at Any Time During Treatment
auditor_notes: Major response = MCyR (complete/partial cytogenetic response) or MaHR for AP-CML - cytogenetic/hematologic, and 'major response' category is excluded.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants Who Experienced a Hematopoietic Response
auditor_notes: Hgb increase >=1.0 g/dL for 4 weeks without transfusion/ESA - anemia endpoint, not tumor response at all.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants With Complete Response (CR) Rate
auditor_notes: CR rate defined as CR + CRi per NCCN criteria (ALL/AML) - composite of CR variants, no PR.

endpoint_title: Complete Response (CR) Rate After Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Etoposide, Prednisone, and Brentuximab Vedotin (CHEP-BV) Induction Therapy
auditor_notes: CR rate after CHEP-BV induction; CR-only, no PR component.

endpoint_title: Clinical Response Rates
auditor_notes: 'Clinical response' = achieving PSA nadir <0.5 ng/mL - biochemical marker response, not objective tumor response. Also 2/2 after early termination (9 enrolled).

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With Response
auditor_notes: Composite: PSA decline >=50% AND/OR radiographic CR/PR per PCWG3; PSA-only responders count, so not strict ORR.

endpoint_title: BICR-Assessed Objective Response Rate (ORR) in Randomized LAG-3 Positive (>=1 %) Participants
auditor_notes: Confirmed BOR of CR or PR / randomized LAG-3-positive participants, RECIST 1.1.

endpoint_title: PSA Response Rate
auditor_notes: PSA >=50% decline confirmed >=3 weeks later - biochemical response.

endpoint_title: Participants With a Response
auditor_notes: Overall response = CR + PR + marrow CR + hematologic improvement - composite including HI and marrow-only CR, broader than CR+PR.

endpoint_title: Clinical Benefit Rate (Percentage), Which Includes Confirmed Tumor Response (Complete Response [CR] or Partial Response [PR]) or Stable Disease (SD)
auditor_notes: Clinical benefit rate explicitly includes SD >=4 cycles alongside confirmed CR/PR.

endpoint_title: Proportion of Patients Who Achieve a Clinical Response
auditor_notes: Clinical response = CR or PR by objective lesion criteria (lesion count/flattening/50% decrease in sum of products of perpendicular diameters) - disease-appropriate objective CR+PR standard (KS-type), analogous to WHO bidimensional criteria.

endpoint_title: Clinical Response to Metformin Intervention
human_actual_endpoint_type: CR+PR of premalignant oral lesions (WHO-style bidimensional)
auditor_notes: CR = disappearance of lesions; PR = >=50% reduction in sum of products of diameters - objective CR+PR by WHO-style measurement, but on premalignant lesions (oral leukoplakia/erythroplakia chemoprevention), not malignant-tumor ORR; flag if pool is restricted to cancer ORR.

endpoint_title: Determine Overall Response Rate
auditor_notes: CR or PR per investigator, RECIST 1.1 or iRECIST (solid tumors) / RANO (GBM); strictly CR+PR.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR = Complete Response [CR] + Partial Response [PR]) in Pediatric Patients Treated With BVD-523FB (Ulixertinib)
auditor_notes: ORR = CR + PR per RECIST 1.1 in evaluable pediatric patients.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Initially Enrolled Patients That Have a Complete Response at Early Response Assessment Compared to Historical Control
auditor_notes: CR rate at early response assessment (after 2 cycles) vs historical control - CR-only at a landmark.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) Per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST 1.1) by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR) in All Cohort A and Cohort B Participants
auditor_notes: CR or PR per RECIST 1.1 by BICR.

endpoint_title: Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) Response (Complete Response [CR] or Partial Response [PR] vs Not CR or PR) (Cohort I)
auditor_notes: OR = CR + PR per RECIST; assessed at 4 months, i.e. objective response rate at that timepoint (allowed per criteria).

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR; Complete Response + Partial Response [CR + PR]) (Phase 2)
auditor_notes: Confirmed CR or PR / analysis population.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR)
auditor_notes: CR or PR per RECIST 1.1.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA) >=50 Response
auditor_notes: PSA decline to 50% of baseline, confirmed >=4 weeks - biochemical response.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) as Assessed Based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumours Version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1)
auditor_notes: BOR of confirmed CR or PR per RECIST v1.1.

endpoint_title: Overall Response Rate
auditor_notes: CR or PR per RECIST 1.1 on treatment.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants With Complete Response at Week 12
human_actual_endpoint_type: CR only (actinic keratosis lesion clearance, landmark)
auditor_notes: Complete clearance of all treated AK lesions at week 12 - CR-only, premalignant dermatology endpoint at a landmark.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants With Objective Response (Part 2)
auditor_notes: CR or PR per RECIST v1.1 with full CR/PR definitions in description.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR)
auditor_notes: Complete or partial tumour response per RECIST v1.1.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) by Investigator Assessment; Target Population Analysis Set
auditor_notes: Confirmed OR (CR or PR), confirmation >=4 weeks, RECIST 1.1.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants With Objective Response (OR) Per the Lugano Classification According to Independent Radiology Review Committee (IRRC) in Cohort 1
auditor_notes: OR = complete/partial metabolic or radiologic response (CMR/CRR/PMR/PRR) per Lugano - the lymphoma-standard CR+PR objective response.

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants Achieving Complete Response (CR) at End of Induction (EOI), as Determined by the Independent Review Committee (IRC) Using Modified Lugano 2014 Criteria
auditor_notes: CR at end of induction per modified Lugano by IRC - CR-only at a landmark.

endpoint_title: Overall Response Rate (ORR)
auditor_notes: BOR of confirmed CR or PR per RECIST 1.1, local investigator.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) (Part 2 Expansion)
auditor_notes: CR or PR per RECIST v1.1.

endpoint_title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) as Assessed by an Independent Central Review (ICR)
auditor_notes: Confirmed CR or PR per RECIST 1.1 by independent central review.

endpoint_title: Proportion of Participants Who Achieve Positron Emission Tomography (PET) - Negative Complete Response
auditor_notes: PET-negative complete response per Lugano 2014 - CR-only.

endpoint_title: Clinical Response Rate
auditor_notes: Registry description gives no response criteria at all ('to estimate the clinical response rate ... after immunotherapy'); trial terminated early. Cannot determine whether CR+PR objective response was meant.

endpoint_title: Assessment of Tumor Response to Combination of Paricalcitol and Hydroxychloroquine With Common Front-line Therapy.
auditor_notes: Title is vague but description explicitly defines the measure as ORR = CR + PR per RECIST 1.1.

endpoint_title: Proportion of Patients With a Complete Clinical Response.
auditor_notes: Complete clinical response by digital rectal exam + sigmoidoscopy appearance (organ-preservation endpoint in rectal cancer) - cCR-only, non-RECIST clinical assessment.

endpoint_title: Overall Response Rate of Ibrutinib in Combination With Obinutuzumab
auditor_notes: Overall response per iwCLL 2008 (OR = CR + PR); description's RECIST boilerplate also states OR = CR + PR. Registry posts 32/32 (100%).

endpoint_title: Maintenance Phase: Percentage of Participants With Remission at Week 66 Among Participants Who Had Achieved a Clinical Response at Week 14, as Determined by the MCS
human_actual_endpoint_type: clinical remission (ulcerative colitis, Mayo Clinic Score)
auditor_notes: Non-oncology endpoint: UC remission at Week 66 by MCS subscores among Week-14 responders.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With a Response
auditor_notes: Response = CR + CRp + CRi within 3 months - CR-variant hematologic composite, no PR.

endpoint_title: Pathological Complete Response (pCR)
auditor_notes: Absence of invasive tumor in breast and axillary nodes at surgery (ypT0/is ypN0).

endpoint_title: Percentage of Participants With Pathological Complete Response (pCR) in the PD-L1-Positive Population (IC 1/2/3)
auditor_notes: pCR (ypT0/is ypN0) after neoadjuvant therapy, PD-L1-positive population.

endpoint_title: Complete Response (CR) Rate (Treatment-Naive Arm)
auditor_notes: CR rate per Cheson 2014 - CR-only, no PR component.

endpoint_title: Number of Participants With a Response, Evaluated According to RECIST 1.1
auditor_notes: Description does not enumerate CR/PR but 'response evaluated according to RECIST 1.1' conventionally means objective response = CR or PR; no broader categories mentioned.

endpoint_title: Phase II: Objective Response Rate
auditor_notes: Objective response rate per RECIST; description states OR = CR + PR.

endpoint_title: Abscopal Response Rate (ARR)
auditor_notes: CR/PR restricted to unirradiated lesions using irRECIST - immune-related criteria variant (excluded) and lesion-subset-restricted, not standard ORR.
